% Known-good: item 1's pic quote is "$\theta$" — a value-FREE angle label
% (no digits anywhere in \node text or pic quotes; coordinates don't count).
% A value-free convention figure may sit on one item of a mixed list, so this
% sheet must PASS: counting "$\theta$" as valued would be a false FAIL that
% teaches generators to strip helpful labels.
\documentclass{article}\usepackage{tikz,enumitem}\usetikzlibrary{angles,quotes}
\begin{document}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=3cm]
  \item The triangle shows how the reference angle is labelled.
    \begin{tikzpicture}
      \coordinate (A) at (0,0); \coordinate (B) at (3,0); \coordinate (C) at (3,2);
      \draw (A) -- (B) -- (C) -- cycle;
      \node[below left] at (A) {$A$};
      \node[below right] at (B) {$B$};
      \node[above] at (C) {$C$};
      \pic [draw, angle radius=7mm, "$\theta$"] {angle = B--A--C};
    \end{tikzpicture}
  \item State which side is opposite the marked angle.
\end{enumerate}
\end{document}
